name: SDV Benevolence
visualNotes: A heavy Stardust cargo transport, built to haul rather than fight. It still wears Stardust grey and still broadcasts its old registry, RT-07. The cargo hold is fitted with six pod cradles.

stats.name: Hull
stats.description: The ship's health. Each point of damage takes 1 off. At 0 the ship is crippled, and the Pilot has to bring it down safely: 15 Successes within 3 rolls, or it crashes.

stats.name: Engine
stats.description: Speed, and how hard the ship is to catch. Adds dice to flying rolls: Low +0, Medium +1, High +2, Extreme +3. Higher tiers make long journeys shorter.

stats.name: Aether Core
stats.description: The ship's power and fuel. Spend 1 charge for +2 dice on any ship roll, or to power a module or upgrade. A journey between continents costs 1 charge. Spending a charge at 0 risks Aether Instability.

stats.name: Shields
stats.description: Take damage off every hit: Light 1, Medium 2, Heavy 3.

stats.name: Stealth
stats.description: How easily the ship slips past patrols and into closed airspace. It stays Low while the ship still broadcasts its Stardust registry.

stats.name: Cargo
stats.description: Units in use out of the hold's space. 1 unit is about a crate or a containment pod. Cargo is what Generate Resources sells.

stats.name: Stardust Heat
stats.description: How hard Stardust is looking for you. At 2 their docks scan you, at 3 their docks are closed to you, and at 4 you're actively hunted. Lie Low brings it down by 1.

modules.name: Bridge
modules.effect: Flying, navigation and mission planning. The Captain works from here. If it's damaged: -2 dice on flying rolls.

modules.name: Engine Room
modules.effect: Powers the rotors. The Engine tier sets speed and how hard the ship is to catch. If it's damaged: -1 Engine tier.

modules.name: Crew Quarters
modules.effect: Room for up to 4 crew. Each crew member costs 1 Crystal of upkeep per downtime. If it's damaged: crew bonuses are halved.

modules.name: Cargo Hold
modules.effect: 6 units of cargo. Still fitted with six Stardust pod cradles. If it's damaged: lose 1 unit of cargo.

conditions.name: Damaged Hull
conditions.description: The Hull is below half. -1 die on flying rolls until it's repaired above half.

conditions.name: Engine Strain
conditions.description: The engines have been pushed too hard. -1 Engine tier until a Repair order clears it.

conditions.name: Aether Instability
conditions.description: The Aether Core was drained past empty. Each charge spent risks a surge: roll a d10, and on 1 to 3 the ship takes 1 Hull damage. A Recharge order clears it.

conditions.name: Crew Conflict
conditions.description: Two crew members are at odds. Neither gives their role bonus until the party backs one of them.

conditions.name: System Malfunction
conditions.description: A module has stopped working. It does nothing until it's repaired (10 Successes).

activeEffects.text: Still broadcasting its Stardust registry: RT-07 "Benevolence".

lockedRegions.name: Restricted Stardust airspace
lockedRegions.requirement: Requires Stealth High or very low Heat

lockedRegions.name: Norten coast (Nirmaan airspace)
lockedRegions.requirement: Requires Stealth Medium or Reputation III

lockedRegions.name: Pustina
lockedRegions.requirement: Requires Reputation IV or a blockade run

lockedRegions.name: Polar Region and the Chione interior

turnActions.name: Repair
turnActions.description: Intelligence + Engineering, rolled until you stop. Every 2 Successes restores 1 Hull. A damaged module needs 10 Successes.

turnActions.name: Recharge
turnActions.description: +2 Aether charges. A full recharge at a city Crystal generator costs 3 Crystals.

turnActions.name: Craft / Install
turnActions.description: Work on installing a module or crafting an item. Progress carries over between turns.

turnActions.name: Generate Resources
turnActions.description: A social roll such as Charisma + Persuasion. You earn Crystals equal to your Successes times the cargo units in use (up to 6). Needs cargo to sell.

turnActions.name: Recruit
turnActions.description: At a dock: Charisma + Persuasion. 3 Successes finds a candidate for a role you name.

turnActions.name: Crew Task
turnActions.description: Spend time with one crew member. On 3 Successes their loyalty goes up one step.

turnActions.name: Lie Low
turnActions.description: Stardust Heat -1. You can't also Generate Resources this turn.

turnActions.name: Refit Identity
turnActions.description: Needs a Workshop Bay. 25 Successes in total for a forged registry and new paint: Stealth goes up one step.

notes.text: Benevolence is Stardust's name for it. Rename it whenever you like.

nodes.name: Engine Mk I
nodes.effect: Engine goes up one tier (Medium to High): +1 die on flying rolls, shorter long journeys, and the storms around the Polar Region can be flown. Standard install: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Basic Cannons
nodes.effect: The ship's first weapon. 6 dice, Damage Threshold 7, Critical 10. A Combat module that takes a bay. Standard install: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Light Shield
nodes.effect: Shields go from None to Light: every hit does 1 less damage. Standard install: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

upgradeTree.name: Specialisation
upgradeTree.unlock: After the first boss. Choose one path per boss defeated.

nodes.name: Aether Cannons II
nodes.effect: Upgrades the cannons to 8 dice with Damage Threshold 6. Needs Basic Cannons. Standard install: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Targeting AI
nodes.effect: +2 dice on ship weapon rolls. If no one takes the Gunner station, the AI fires with 5 dice. Standard install: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Workshop Bay
nodes.effect: Crafting and install jobs need 25% fewer Successes, and the party can craft gear aboard. Needed for Refit Identity. Standard module: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Scanner Array
nodes.effect: +2 dice on scanning and navigation. Once per mission, reveal one hidden location nearby. Standard module: 50 Crystals or 2 Components.

nodes.name: Bond Chamber
nodes.effect: +2 dice on Willpower checks tied to the bond. Once per downtime, remove one bond-related Status. Advanced module: 100 Crystals or 4 Components.

nodes.name: Resonance Engine
nodes.effect: Once per mission, spend 2 Aether charges: every Ethereal aboard gets back one used spell slot. Advanced module: 100 Crystals or 4 Components.

nodes.name: Phase Weapons
nodes.effect: Spend 1 Aether charge when the ship fires: that attack ignores the target's shields. Advanced install: 100 Crystals or 4 Components.

nodes.name: Energy Efficiency Systems
nodes.effect: Aether Core +2 maximum, and a Recharge order restores 3 charges instead of 2. Advanced install: 100 Crystals or 4 Components.

nodes.name: Auto-Repair Combat Systems
nodes.effect: At the end of each ship combat round, repair 1 Hull. Once per combat, a damaged module comes back online by itself. Advanced install: 100 Crystals or 4 Components.

nodes.name: Event Horizon Core
nodes.effect: Once per mission, a gravity well pins enemy ships in place: they can't escape, and every ally gets +2 dice to hit them this round. Risk: the strain does 2 Hull damage. Uses an Ethereal upgrade slot.

nodes.name: Prism Overdrive
nodes.effect: Once per mission, for one round: ship weapons +3 dice, Engine +1 tier and Shields +1 step. Risk: afterwards every module works at half strength until the next airship turn. Uses an Ethereal upgrade slot.

nodes.name: Temporal Relay
nodes.effect: Once per mission, take one extra station action, or rewind the last ship roll and make it again. Risk: the ship loses its next round. Uses an Ethereal upgrade slot.

upgradeTree.name: Forbidden Upgrades
upgradeTree.unlock: Through the black market or the story.

nodes.name: Dual-Core Ethereal Engine
nodes.effect: A second Aether Core: maximum charges doubled, and two Ethereal upgrades can fire in the same round. Risk (1 to 3): both cores surge, giving Aether Instability and 3 Hull damage. Stardust Heat +1 when installed.

nodes.name: Overbond Amplifier
nodes.effect: For one mission, every bonded Ethereal aboard gets +2 dice on their Ethereal powers and spells. Risk (1 to 3): the bond frays, and the Ethereal takes a Status of the GM's choice. Stardust Heat +1 when installed.

nodes.name: Black Veil Drive
nodes.effect: Stealth becomes High while it runs, and the ship can slip into closed airspace unseen. Costs 1 Aether charge per journey. Risk (1 to 3): reality bends around the hull, and the GM rolls an airship event straight away. Stardust Heat +1 when installed.
